episodes.title: Day One
lines: Good evening from somewhere above Nebraska, this is Dale and Tammy, live from the cow ship.
We were arguing about the air filter in the truck and then the sky went green.
He was arguing. I was correct.
Anyway. The aliens said sorry, we are not cows, would we like to go back.
And we looked at each other, and we looked at the truck, and we said, you know what, we're good.
Honestly, best vacation we have ever had. The beds hum.

episodes.title: Ten Cows
lines: Big news on the ship today. The black hole out the window ate its tenth cow.
He named them. All ten. We did not know them.
Number seven was a Gerald. You could tell.
The crew says the hole purrs when it eats. I say that is a stomach noise.
Either way, the lights in the hallway stopped flickering. So, thank you Gerald.
Keep sending cows, folks. The hallway appreciates it.

episodes.title: Thirty
lines: Thirty cows in, and the black hole has, and I am quoting the captain here, filled out.
It is bigger. It is noticeably bigger. I measured it with my thumb.
He held his thumb up to a window. That is not measuring.
Also the whole ship feels warmer. Tammy has started redecorating the pod bay.
Somebody has to. Teal and chrome everywhere. It is like living inside a toaster.
A very comfortable toaster. We are not leaving.

episodes.title: Seventy-Five
lines: Folks, the sky outside changed colour overnight. Seventy-five cows will do that, apparently.
Dale, I sold curtains for eleven years. It is mauve.
The captain says the hole is bending light now. I say it is bending my marriage.
Nothing is bending your marriage, honey. Send more cows, people. He needs a hobby.

episodes.title: Company
lines: Okay, so, a second ship just warped in next to us. Hundred and fifty cows and we have neighbours.
I think it is the in-laws.
It is not my mother, Dale. It is a different species.
The crew is thrilled. Apparently a hole this size draws a crowd. We are famous out here.
Wave at the new ship if you see it. And if it waves back with a tentacle, that is Carol.

episodes.title: Three Hundred
lines: Three hundred cows. The black hole is enormous. You can see it from the bathroom.
It has a glow now. Like a nightlight. I have grown very fond of it.
The captain gave us a plaque. It says, honorary cargo. We are very proud.
We talked about going home. For about a minute.
Then the beds started humming again, and, well.
This is Dale and Tammy, live from the cow ship. We are enjoying it. Good night, Earth.
